title: Gorgonzola Pasta Bake
description: A creamy, cheesy pasta dish featuring gorgonzola cheese, perfect for a cozy dinner. This recipe combines the bold flavors of Norway with the richness of Italy.

ingredients.name: Gorgonzola cheese
ingredients.notes: Crumbly or soft, whichever you prefer

ingredients.name: Norwegian nutty oil
ingredients.notes: You can substitute with olive oil if you can't find nutty oil

instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
In a large skillet, heat the Norwegian nutty oil over medium heat.
Add the gorgonzola cheese and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet, tossing to combine with the cheese sauce.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with additional gorgonzola cheese if desired.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is bubbly.
Remove from the oven and garnish with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
